# Radoslav Radev Says The Goal Is To Finish A Workout 70% Exhausted And Still Able To Repeat Productive Attempts On The Hardest Progression

Radoslav Radev says the goal is not to be 100% exhausted but to finish the workout 70% exhausted, still able to repeat productive attempts on the hardest progression, and then stop. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 01:22]

## Details

- The goal is to finish the workout 70% exhausted, not 100% exhausted. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 01:22]
- The workout is good if at the end you can repeat productive attempts on your hardest progression, and you stop the workout there. [src: vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 01:38]

## Evidence

- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 01:22 (Radoslav Radev): "the goal is in the end of the workout to not be 100% exhausted to finish the workout 70% exhausted"
- vid-e4gjJgvWViQ @ 01:38 (Radoslav Radev): "here is how you can know if the workout is good in the end of the workout if you can repeat also productive attempts on your hardest progression and you stop the workout there"
